title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named UCI places for studying, connecting, recharging, recreation, and campus programs, each supported by a direct university or library source.

cards.title: Aldrich Park
cards.subtitle: UC Irvine campus green at the center of campus life
cards.notes: Use the paths between classes or pause on the lawn before your next stop; campus life resources describe UCI as centered around this park.
cards.short_summary: The central green space that links much of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Irvine describes its campus life as centered around Aldrich Park.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus rules and event restrictions.

cards.title: UCI Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student Center · Ring Road area
cards.notes: Make this a practical between-class stop for study, services, and campus programs; the building lists quiet spaces and reservable rooms.
cards.short_summary: A central building for study rooms, student services, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCI Student Center provides quiet places to sit, work, or read and rooms available for reservation.
cards.source_title: UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Building hours are listed as 7:00 a.m.–midnight daily, excluding university holidays.

cards.title: Courtyard Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: First floor, UCI Student Center, near the Meditation Space
cards.notes: Reserve a group room when you need whiteboards, power, and Wi-Fi; reservations use a current UCInetID and depend on availability.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Student Center study rooms with useful group-work amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Courtyard Study Lounge has reservable study rooms plus Wi-Fi, whiteboards, power, vending machines, and restrooms.
cards.source_title: Book a Study Room Online | UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7:30 a.m.–11:30 p.m.; study rooms are for UCI students and require reservations.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Information Center, first-floor entrance of the UCI Student Center
cards.notes: Use the seating, outlets, Wi-Fi, microwave, and refrigerator during a long gap; ask in person about a same-day locker if needed.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center lounge designed for students spending long days on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commuter Lounge offers lounge seating, power outlets, Wi-Fi, a microwave, refrigerator, and day-use lockers.
cards.source_title: Commuter Lounge | UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Lounge hours are Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–8:00 p.m. and weekends 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; lockers are day-of for UCI students.

cards.title: Cross-Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: Ring Road, across from Starbucks and Aldrich Hall
cards.notes: Check the center’s programs or sit down with peers in an affirming campus setting; student organizations can pursue room reservations through its process.
cards.short_summary: A Ring Road center for identity exploration, community, and student-led programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cross-Cultural Center says its space supports students in exploring social identities, building relationships, and promoting lifelong learning.
cards.access_notes: The center lists Spring 2026 building hours as daily, 8:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; check the site for quarter updates.

cards.entity_name: Center for Black Cultures, Resources and Research
cards.title: Center for Black Cultures, Resources and Research
cards.subtitle: UCI Student Center, Level 1, Room B116
cards.notes: Visit the Student Center location to learn about its culturally supportive programming and resources, or check its own site before attending an activity.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center cultural resource space supporting Black student thriving.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI states that the Center for Black Cultures, Resources and Research provides a safe, vibrant, inclusive, culturally supportive space where Black students can thrive.
cards.source_title: Services | UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Center at Level 1, Room B116; consult the center for programming and access details.

cards.title: UCI DREAM Center
cards.subtitle: RISE Suite, UCI Student Center Level 4, Room G458
cards.notes: Use this Student Center base to find programming and support related to immigration policy; contact the center for current services and gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center space serving people affected by immigration policy.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI describes the DREAM Center as serving those impacted by immigration policy through systemic change, personal growth, collective healing, and visible change.
cards.source_title: Services | UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Located in the RISE Suite at Level 4, Room G458; contact dream@uci.edu for current details.

cards.title: Langson Library
cards.subtitle: UC Irvine Libraries · central campus
cards.notes: Choose the third floor when collaborating with a group, or use the designated quiet zones when you need a lower-noise study setting.
cards.short_summary: A major UCI library with group areas, quiet zones, and reservable study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries identifies Langson's third floor as a group study area and lists quiet-study zones in its basement, fourth floor, and Special Collections.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms may be booked by current UCI students, staff, and faculty; check library hours and room availability before going.

cards.title: Science Library
cards.subtitle: UC Irvine Libraries · Science Library
cards.notes: Use the open study seating or reserve a study room for focused group work; keep conversations out of the fourth- and sixth-floor quiet zones.
cards.short_summary: A large library study setting with reservable rooms and designated quiet floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries states that the Science Library has over 30 study rooms, 2,000 individual study spaces, and quiet-study zones on floors four and six.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms may be booked by current UCI students, staff, and faculty; verify library hours and reservations online.

cards.title: Gateway Study Center
cards.subtitle: Across from Langson Library · 106 Gateway Study Center
cards.notes: Check the Study Space Locator for a reservable room, or look for SOAR Center study-support programming during the quarter and finals period.
cards.short_summary: A study-center building across from Langson with reservable rooms and SOAR programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries states that Gateway Study Center is across from Langson Library and offers 13 reservable study rooms; SOAR is located at 106 Gateway Study Center.
cards.access_notes: Library information says Gateway has 13 study rooms reservable through the Study Space Locator; it is open 24 hours during 10th and Finals weeks.
